'''obi-wan-wonder Death Star Dynasty (new and improved)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[obi-wan-wonder]]
* '''Published:''' 25 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)|CC-D-cloudcityeastplatformdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Cloud City East Platform (Docking B DeathSta.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This really has nothing to do with the death star, it is just the new and improved deck of Death Star Dynasty.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I use my star destroyers and starships to control space. I put most of my pilots in them to add to their power so it would be an unlikely event i they get hit or lost. I put in a couple strategic planets for my star destroyers so i can generate excess force and force drain. If i have all my planets out then i can force drain six times with just my planets. i can then force drain more with my opponents planets which usually have two force icons.

I have a couple ground troops. General Veers goes in the at-at and Avirak goes in the speeder bike with Niado Duagad with a jetpack. I deplpoy them on the rebe base and they march in battling. This would work the best on a planet like endor or hoth. If i control my Endor sites I can Force drain four more times there too.

My effects and interrupts are for force draining, capturing people and adding to the deploy cost of things.

be sure to look at my new and improved Rebl hoth deck that will be coming soon.
